subject: Mini-sprint security briefing for VaultBank — compressed SOC 2 / pen / DPA review
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Short security sync request

Hi Neha,

We're about to kick off procurement and the security team has a couple of quick gating questions around SOC 2 coverage, pen-test cadence, and DPA scoping. Would Redwood be able to do a short, focused briefing — 30 minutes max — next week? We're trying to compress the normal intake so we can greenlight a PO this quarter.

Ideal times for us: Wed-Fri afternoon US-ET (we can also do early EU morning). If you can do a tightly structured mini-sprint that covers: (1) SOC 2 artifact map, (2) pen-test approach & timeline, (3) DPA data flow & retention — that would be perfect.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security Operations
VaultBank

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Short security sync request

Thanks Liam — definitely doable. We'll run a 30-minute "mini-sprint" that sticks to the three bullets you listed and leaves 5 minutes for any procurement redlines.

Proposed options (all 30 min):
- Option A: Wed Jul 27, 4:00–4:30 PM ET (US-friendly)
- Option B: Thu Jul 28, 9:00–9:30 AM BST (EU morning / US late night)
- Option C: Fri Jul 29, 1:00–1:30 PM ET (flexible)

What we will bring: a one-page control matrix mapping SOC 2 controls to Redwood artifacts, pen-test cadence + vendor approach summary, and a short DPA dataflow diagram.

Can you confirm one slot and whether you want the meeting recorded? Also, do you have a pre-prepared list of must-cover controls or a procurement checklist we should align to? If you can attach that, we'll tailor the deck.

I'll loop in Marissa and Camila to coordinate engineers and compliance SMEs.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultbank.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 18:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Short security sync request

Adding our availability and resource notes.

We can support any of the three options; confirmed attendees from our side: me (product security), Camila (solutions engineer), and a short block from our infrastructure lead if you want someone to answer deep architecture questions (we can keep that person optional on call).

For the mini-sprint flow I suggest: 5 min intros + 15 min focused artifacts (control matrix + pen approach) + 5 min DPA/dataflow + 5 min Q&A/action items. We'll put the one-pager and a sample pen-test statement in a shared Drive ahead of time.

Also: if VaultBank has an evidence map or a prioritized control list, please share it — we will highlight exact artifacts to attach post-call (S3 paths, report extracts, attestation dates).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 08:25:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Mini-sprint security briefing for VaultBank — compressed SOC 2 / pen / DPA review

Thanks — booking Option C to give your procurement team one last business-day to confirm:

Fri Jul 29, 2028 13:00–13:30 ET / 18:00–18:30 BST (30 min)
Bridge: Zoom (details in invite)
Agenda (30 min):
- 00:00–05:00 Quick intros & objectives
- 05:00–20:00 SOC 2 control matrix mapping (highlights / gaps / evidence locations)
- 20:00–25:00 Pen-test cadence & scope summary (what we do, recommended vendors, timelines)
- 25:00–28:00 DPA dataflow & retention highlights
- 28:00–30:00 Actions / next steps / PO gating items

Attached: control_matrix.xlsx (one-page mapping) + mini-sprint-bridge.ics (calendar invite). If you prefer a different slot, tell us and we'll shuffle.

Pre-req: if you can upload a short prioritized control checklist (3–5 must-have items) to the Drive link below, we'll ensure the briefing directly addresses your procurement gates.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_control_matrix_shared

Recording: we typically record the session for internal follow-up; we'll only enable recording with your sign-off.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: control_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 42KB), mini-sprint-bridge.ics (text/calendar, 1KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@vaultbank.com
Date: Sun, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Mini-sprint security briefing for VaultBank — compressed SOC 2 / pen / DPA review

Thanks Neha — Fri Jul 29 13:00 ET works for us. Please keep recording off (procurement wants notes only). I've uploaded our prioritized checklist to the Drive you shared (file: VB_priority_controls.pdf).

Two requests before the call:
1) Can you flag any controls in your matrix that require customer-side evidence vs. Redwood-side artifacts? We'll pre-gather customer evidence to avoid follow-up loops.
2) If you recommend a short-form pen-test statement, please include a suggested vendor shortlist and an estimated lead time (weeks).

See you Friday,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security Operations
VaultBank
